about: The live bad_deploy break of 2026-11-12, evening: break at 20:00:14, errors into ALARM at 20:00:45, cleared by hand at 20:01:51, OK at 20:02:25. Two runs diagnosed it at once: the runtime's, and a local one (transcript 20261112T200112Z, local). The morning's two breaks are in the deploy history, 12 hours earlier. No other alarm fired.
account: 123456789012 stands in for the account ID wherever AWS wrote it.

logs.note: Lines without their EMF _aws block, as the log tool shows them.

metrics.note: CloudWatch keeps 10-second data for 3 hours, so only 60-second periods remain.
